# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, glob, os, datetime, io

SESS_DIR = r"C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions"
OUT = r"C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/dsh_review_result.txt"

TZ = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))
NOW = datetime.datetime(2026,11,26,8,0,3,tzinfo=TZ)
D = (NOW - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).date()  # 2026-11-25
start = datetime.datetime(D.year,D.month,D.day,0,0,0,tzinfo=TZ).timestamp()
end = start + 86400
print("D =", D, "window(s)=",start,"to",end, file=io.StringIO())

def gv(rows, key):
    n = rows.get(key)
    return n.get("val") if isinstance(n,dict) else None

recs=[]
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(SESS_DIR,"session-*.json")):
    m = os.path.getmtime(f)
    if not (start <= m < end):
        continue
    try:
        data = json.load(open(f,encoding="utf-8"))
        rows = data["record"]["rows"]
        tu = gv(rows,"tokenUsage") or {}
        totals = tu.get("totals") or {}
        ss = gv(rows,"sessionStats") or {}
        ms = gv(rows,"modelSelection") or {}
        cp = gv(rows,"contextPressure") or {}
        sid = os.path.basename(f).replace("session-","").replace(".json","")
        recs.append({
            "sid":sid,
            "title":gv(rows,"title") or "",
            "uncached":totals.get("uncachedInputTokens",0),
            "cacheRead":totals.get("cacheReadTokens",0),
            "output":totals.get("outputTokens",0),
            "steps":ss.get("steps",0),
            "turns":ss.get("turns",0),
            "model":(ms.get("lastUsed") or {}).get("model",""),
            "provider":(ms.get("lastUsed") or {}).get("provider",""),
            "contextPressure":cp.get("pressureTokens",0),
            "mtime":m,
        })
    except Exception as e:
        recs.append({"sid":os.path.basename(f),"error":str(e)})

lines=[]
def p(s=""): lines.append(str(s))

p("D="+str(D)+"  window="+datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(start,TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")+" ~ "+datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(end,TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
p("matched files (by mtime): "+str(len(recs)))

good=[r for r in recs if "error" not in r]
bad=[r for r in recs if "error" in r]
for b in bad: p("PARSE_ERR "+b["sid"]+" "+b["error"])

tU=sum(r["uncached"] for r in good)
tC=sum(r["cacheRead"] for r in good)
tO=sum(r["output"] for r in good)
tEq=sum(r["cacheRead"]*0.1+r["uncached"]+r["output"]*4 for r in good)
p("totals uncached=%d cacheRead=%d output=%d eq=%.0f"%(tU,tC,tO,tEq))
overall_hit = tC/(tC+tU)*100 if (tC+tU) else 0
p("overall cache hit=%.1f%%"%overall_hit)

for r in good:
    r["eq"]=r["cacheRead"]*0.1+r["uncached"]+r["output"]*4
    r["hit"]=r["cacheRead"]/(r["cacheRead"]+r["uncached"])*100 if (r["cacheRead"]+r["uncached"]) else 0
    r["uncPerStep"]=r["uncached"]/r["steps"] if r["steps"] else r["uncached"]

p("\n--- TOP8 by eq cost ---")
for r in sorted(good,key=lambda x:-x["eq"])[:8]:
    p("eq=%7.0f hit=%5.1f%% unc=%6d cache=%7d out=%5d steps=%3d turns=%2d model=%s sid=%s | %s"%(
        r["eq"],r["hit"],r["uncached"],r["cacheRead"],r["output"],r["steps"],r["turns"],r["model"],r["sid"],r["title"][:40]))

p("\n--- TOP8 by steps ---")
for r in sorted(good,key=lambda x:-x["steps"])[:8]:
    p("steps=%3d turns=%2d eq=%7.0f unc/step=%5.0f hit=%5.1f%% sid=%s | %s"%(
        r["steps"],r["turns"],r["eq"],r["uncPerStep"],r["hit"],r["sid"],r["title"][:40]))

tSteps=sum(r["steps"] for r in good); tTurns=sum(r["turns"] for r in good)
p("\nsum steps=%d turns=%d avg steps=%.2f avg turns=%.2f (n=%d)"%(tSteps,tTurns,tSteps/len(good) if good else 0,tTurns/len(good) if good else 0,len(good)))

p("\n--- anomalies: low cache hit <80% ---")
for r in good:
    if r["hit"]<80 and (r["uncached"]+r["cacheRead"])>1000:
        p("hit=%.1f%% unc=%d cache=%d eq=%.0f sid=%s | %s"%(r["hit"],r["uncached"],r["cacheRead"],r["eq"],r["sid"],r["title"][:40]))

p("\n--- anomalies: unc/step >12k ---")
for r in good:
    if r["uncPerStep"]>12000 and r["steps"]>0:
        p("unc/step=%.0f unc=%d steps=%d eq=%.0f sid=%s | %s"%(r["uncPerStep"],r["uncached"],r["steps"],r["eq"],r["sid"],r["title"][:40]))

p("\n--- anomalies: single session eq share >20% ---")
for r in good:
    if tEq and r["eq"]/tEq>0.20:
        p("share=%.1f%% eq=%.0f sid=%s | %s"%(r["eq"]/tEq*100,r["eq"],r["sid"],r["title"][:40]))

p("\n--- model distribution ---")
from collections import Counter
p(str(Counter(r["model"] for r in good)))

open(OUT,"w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(lines))
print("wrote",OUT,"lines",len(lines))
print("D=",D,"matched",len(recs))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, glob, os, datetime, io

SESS_DIR = r"C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions"
OUT = r"C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/dsh_review_errors.txt"
TZ = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))
D = datetime.date(2026,11,25)
start = datetime.datetime(D.year,D.month,D.day,tzinfo=TZ).timestamp()
end = start+86400

def gv(rows,k):
    n=rows.get(k); return n.get('val') if isinstance(n,dict) else None

hits=[]
kw = ["失败","拒绝","报错","异常","重试","返工","卡住","不可用","回退","回滚","失败排查","push失败","404","500","error","fail","reject","stall","INVALID","denied","构建失败","编译失败"]
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(SESS_DIR,"session-*.json")):
    m=os.path.getmtime(f)
    if not (start<=m<end): continue
    try:
        rows=json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8'))["record"]["rows"]
    except: continue
    sid=os.path.basename(f).replace("session-","").replace(".json","")
    title=gv(rows,"title") or ""
    reasons=[]
    # structured signals
    lr=gv(rows,"llmRetry")
    if lr:
        s=json.dumps(lr,ensure_ascii=False)
        if any(x in s.lower() for x in ["fail","error","retry","attempt"]):
            reasons.append("llmRetry="+s[:120])
    goal=gv(rows,"goal")
    if isinstance(goal,dict) and goal.get("failure"):
        reasons.append("goal.failure="+json.dumps(goal["failure"],ensure_ascii=False)[:120])
    cc=gv(rows,"conversationContinuation")
    if isinstance(cc,dict) and cc.get("failedAttempt"):
        reasons.append("failedAttempt=true")
    # title keyword
    tmatch=[k for k in kw if k.lower() in title.lower()]
    if tmatch: reasons.append("标题命中:"+",".join(tmatch))
    if reasons:
        hits.append((sid,title,reasons))

lines=[f"命中会话数: {len(hits)}"]
for sid,title,reasons in sorted(hits,key=lambda x:x[1]):
    lines.append(f"\n[{sid}] {title}")
    for r in reasons: lines.append("   - "+r)
open(OUT,"w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(lines))
print("hits",len(hits),"->",OUT)
